evidence_type: static REA observations bound to original IL2CPP v31 bytes
limitations: No game execution or runtime callback order observation.
Decompiler text can include inlined callees and followed tail calls; references are not all direct caller edges.
A shared native address retains all metadata aliases; a seed label alone does not prove the receiver type.
Raw E8 patterns only corroborate decompiler targets within the selected PE unwind range; instruction boundaries are not independently decoded here.
TypeInfo usage tags and registered fields give static identity/layout, not current runtime values.
Input declarations/bindings and selected prefab configuration are separately recorded in assets/player-config.json; no runtime input or physics was observed.

configuration_dependency.boundary: Separately decoded original asset configuration and metadata enum values; default bindings do not establish runtime overrides.

jump_input_boundary.scope: Exact lVar2 InputData.Jump stores in this saved Resolve body; not a global no-write proof for all native code or runtime modifications.

scope: PlayerController to input resolution, locomotion, actions and selected interaction paths in the pinned build
